label: Опыт
description: A 10-sentence usage card for опыт (experience; experiment).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Опыт' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'работы' is genitive showing of what. A natural sentence about a person's background.

Strategic focus: Accusative inanimate object. 'Опыт' is the accusative direct object of 'получил'; as an inanimate masculine noun, its accusative copies the nominative form. 'Полезный' agrees with it.

Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Опыта' is genitive after the negated 'нет', which always governs the genitive. 'Такого' agrees in the masculine genitive. A core pattern for admitting a lack.

Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Опыту' is dative after 'благодаря', which governs the dative to express thanks to something. 'Быстро справился' states the result. A useful cause-and-effect template.

Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Опытом' is instrumental after 'поделился', which governs the instrumental for sharing. 'Своим' is the agreeing masculine instrumental pronoun. A common professional sentence.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Опыте' is the prepositional form after 'на', the basis on which one learns. 'Собственном' is the agreeing masculine prepositional adjective. A reflective, idiomatic pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Опыты' is the nominative plural subject, here in the sense of experiments. 'Эти' agrees in plural, and 'успешно' describes the outcome. A good science-lab sentence.

Strategic focus: Accusative inanimate plural. 'Опыты' is the accusative plural; as an inanimate noun, the accusative copies the nominative plural form. 'Новые' agrees, and 'проводят' is the verb of conducting.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Опытов' is the genitive plural after 'результаты', expressing the results of the experiments. 'Результаты' stays nominative as the subject. A precise scientific sentence.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Опытом' is instrumental after the preposition 'с', describing how he works. 'Большим' is the agreeing masculine instrumental adjective. A useful pattern for describing competence.
